name: Electronic Components Inc. dba eComp
old_description: Electronic Component Testing, Counterfeit Mitigation & Authentication and Component Engineering
about:
Electronic Components Inc., doing business as eComp, is headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, with a facility in Nashua, New Hampshire. The company's founding date and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

eComp operates as a specialty distributor and authenticator of electronic components, focusing on hard-to-find, obsolete, and legacy parts for military, aerospace, medical, and industrial markets. Its services include electronic component testing, counterfeit mitigation and authentication, component engineering, procurement outsourcing, DNA marking, and bill-of-materials analysis. The company also offers contract manufacturing for new and legacy designs, providing custom replacement solutions for obsolete products and systems.

The company serves customers in the defense, aerospace, medical, industrial, automotive, and commercial sectors. Named clients include Ametek, BAE Systems, the U.S. Department of Defense, EADS, General Dynamics, General Electric, L3Harris (formerly L-3 COM), Lockheed Martin, Raytheon, Thales, Sanmina-SCI, and Sypris.

eComp states its mission is to deliver quality products at the best price and service, reduce customers' standard costs, share industry trend knowledge, and build long-term partnerships with electronics manufacturers. Its vision centers on enabling the production of legacy systems today while supporting life-cycle requirements for tomorrow.
